verdict.headline: This high-risk order combines an unverified account, expensive overnight shipping, and a package forwarder with a mismatched recipient name.

signals.finding: The buyer's PayPal account is unverified.
The order uses overnight express shipping and costs $236.00, matching typical stolen-account fraud patterns.
The shipping address is a package forwarder (ParcelBridge Forwarding) with a different recipient name (R. Vance) than the PayPal payer (Tomas Reyes).
The buyer has no completed orders or history with the shop.

actions: Ship only to the verified PayPal address on the transaction (1450 SW 8th St, Miami, FL) or cancel and refund the order
Require signature confirmation if shipping to an approved alternate address

trace.summary: Order SCE0N2ECCN6E2QJ8J: $236.00, Overnight express, ships to R. Vance c/o ParcelBridge Forwarding in Doral, FL
